description: A `!` function's envelope on ./a.db reaches a `.nobatch()` write to ./b.db: still E-SQL-011 (before s474 r1 it compiled and the write survived the rollback).
rationale: §8.9.5: `.nobatch()` excludes a query from coalescing candidate sets — the trigger count — not from the envelope's extent; §8.9.2: a write to database B that the envelope's extent can reach SHALL be E-SQL-011.
